title: Redeem function active when vault is paused
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High - Allows unauthorized withdrawal of assets during critical situations when the vault is paused.  **Likelihood:** Low - This issue occurs only when the vault is in a paused state.  ## Description  The vault's deposit, mint, and withdraw functionalities are halted when it is paused.
